caption: Attribute Dictionary
description: The Attribute Dictionary defines schema attributes and includes references to the events and objects in which they are used.
name: dictionary

adjusted_metric_list.caption: Adjusted Metric List
adjusted_metric_list.description: A list of CVSS environmental metrics that were modified by the vendor, including the metric name and the reason for the modification.

adjusted_score.caption: Adjusted Score
adjusted_score.description: The recalculated CVSS score after environmental modifications are applied by the vendor.

adjusted_vector_string.caption: Adjusted Vector String
adjusted_vector_string.description: The modified CVSS scoring vector with environmental metrics appended by the vendor.

attach_time.caption: Attach Time
attach_time.description: The time stamp when the volume was attached to the instance

attachments.caption: List of Attachments
attachments.description: A list of attachments to the resource

cidr_block.caption: CIDR Block
cidr_block.description: The CIDR block of the subnet

cloud_function.caption: Cloud Function
cloud_function.description: The cloud function that processes events

cluster_members.caption: Database Cluster Members
cluster_members.description: List of database instance that are part of the database cluster.

cluster_uid.caption: Cluster UID
cluster_uid.description: The unique identifier for the container cluster

content_policy_filters.caption: Content Policy Filters
content_policy_filters.description: A list of content policy filter results from an AI guardrail evaluation. Each filter describes the assessment of content against a specific category such as hate speech, violence, or prompt attacks.

contributing_findings.caption: Contributing Findings
contributing_findings.description: A list of contributing finding objects describing the before and after state of each finding affected by a remediation target.

cvss_metric.caption: CVSS Metric
cvss_metric.description: The CVSS environmental metric that was modified. Values correspond to CVSS v3.x/v4.0 environmental metric abbreviations.

db_cluster.caption: Database Cluster
db_cluster.description: The details of the database cluster.

db_endpoint.caption: Database Endpoint
db_endpoint.description: The database endpoint that is associated with the resource

db_user.caption: Database User
db_user.description: The details of the user account that is the database administrator (e.g. admin).

engine.caption: Engine
engine.description: The engine that is associated with the database

guardrail_evaluation_result.caption: Guardrail Evaluation Result
guardrail_evaluation_result.description: The aggregate outcome of an AI guardrail evaluation, including the source of content evaluated and the combined content policy filter results.

handler.caption: Handler
handler.description: The method in the cloud function that processes events

hosted_zone_uid.caption: Hosted Zone UID
hosted_zone_uid.description: The unique identifier of a hosted zone (e.g. AWS Route 53 Hosted Zone).

imported_time.caption: Imported Date and Time
imported_time.description: The timestamp when the certificate was imported

in_use_by.caption: In Use By
in_use_by.description: List of resources currently using this certificate

in_use_count.caption: In Use Count
in_use_count.description: Count of resources using this image. See specific usage.

instance_profile.caption: Instance Profile
instance_profile.description: Information about the instance profile associated with the compute resource, which provides the resource with permissions to interact with other services

instance_profiles.caption: Instance Profiles
instance_profiles.description: A list of instance profiles associated with the compute resource, which provides the resource with permissions to interact with other services

ip_addresses.caption: IP Address Array
ip_addresses.description: An array of IP addresses (IPv4 or IPv6) associated with the instance. These may include both public and private IP addresses.

ip_count.caption: IP Count
ip_count.description: The number of IP addresses in the subnet

is_delete_on_termination.caption: Is Delete on Termination
is_delete_on_termination.description: Specifies whether the volume will be deleted on instance termination

is_iam_authentication.caption: IAM Database Authentication Enabled
is_iam_authentication.description: Indicates if IAM database authentication is enabled

is_immediate.caption: Is Immediate
is_immediate.description: Indicates whether the remediation fix takes effect immediately upon application, or requires additional rollout steps such as redeployment of affected resources.

key_usages.caption: Key Usages
key_usages.description: Key usage defines the purpose of the key contained in the certificate.

ANY.caption: ANY
ANY.description: The public key can be used for any purpose.

CERTIFICATE_SIGNING.caption: CERTIFICATE_SIGNING
CERTIFICATE_SIGNING.description: Used when the public key is used for verifying a signature on certificates.

CRL_SIGNING.caption: CRL_SIGNING
CRL_SIGNING.description: Used when the public key is used for verifying a signature on Certificate Revocation Lists.

CUSTOM.caption: CUSTOM
CUSTOM.description: A custom usage defined by the event source.

DATA_ENCIPHERMENT.caption: DATA_ENCIPHERMENT
DATA_ENCIPHERMENT.description: Used when the public key is used for directly encrypting user data.

DECIPHER_ONLY.caption: DECIPHER_ONLY
DECIPHER_ONLY.description: Used only for deciphering data during key agreement.

DIGITAL_SIGNATURE.caption: DIGITAL_SIGNATURE
DIGITAL_SIGNATURE.description: Used when the public key is used for verifying digital signatures.

ENCIPHER_ONLY.caption: ENCIPHER_ONLY
ENCIPHER_ONLY.description: Used only for enciphering data during key agreement.

KEY_AGREEMENT.caption: KEY_AGREEMENT
KEY_AGREEMENT.description: Used when the sender and receiver of the public key need to derive a key without using encryption.

KEY_ENCIPHERMENT.caption: KEY_ENCIPHERMENT
KEY_ENCIPHERMENT.description: Used when the public key is used for encrypting private or secret keys.

NON_REPUDIATION.caption: NON_REPUDIATION
NON_REPUDIATION.description: Used when the public key is used to verify digital signatures used for non-repudiation services.

last_used_time.caption: Last Used time
last_used_time.description: The time stamp when the resource was last used. See specific usage.

launch_time.caption: Launch Time
launch_time.description: The reported time a device or instance was launched

layers.caption: Cloud Function Layers
layers.description: The list of layers associated with the cloud function.

likelihood.caption: Likelihood
likelihood.description: The likelihood, normalized to the caption of the likelihood_id value. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source.

likelihood_id.caption: Likelihood ID
likelihood_id.description: The normalized likelihood of the finding. Per NIST, this is a weighted factor based on a subjective analysis of the probability that a given threat is capable of exploiting a given vulnerability or a set of vulnerabilities.

1.caption: Very Low
1.description: The probability of the threat exploiting the vulnerability is very low.

2.caption: Low
2.description: The probability of the threat exploiting the vulnerability is low.

3.caption: Moderate
3.description: The probability of the threat exploiting the vulnerability is moderate.

4.caption: High
4.description: The probability of the threat exploiting the vulnerability is high.

5.caption: Very High
5.description: The probability of the threat exploiting the vulnerability is very high.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The likelihood is not mapped to the defined enum values. See the likelihood attribute, which contains a data source specific value.

references.description: NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1, Guide for Conducting Risk Assessments

network_interface.caption: Network Interface
network_interface.description: The Network Interface object describes the type and associated attributes of a physical or virtual network interface.

network_scan_info.caption: Network Scan Info
network_scan_info.description: The network scan job metadata object describing scan timestamps, completion status, scanner endpoints, and operational flags.

platform.caption: Platform Name
platform.description: The operating system platform of the image. See specific usage.

port_info.caption: Port Info
port_info.description: The port and transport protocol details.

port_scan_result_list.caption: Port Scan Result List
port_scan_result_list.description: A list of port scan result objects, each describing the probe outcome for a single port on the scanned host.

post_remediation_steps.caption: Post-Remediation Steps
post_remediation_steps.description: An ordered list of follow-up remediation steps to perform after the primary fix is applied, such as redeploying affected instances or rotating credentials.

registry_uid.caption: Registry UID
registry_uid.description: The unique identifier of a container registry (e.g. AWS ECR Registry ID).

remediation_outcome.caption: Remediation Outcome
remediation_outcome.description: The aggregate outcome of remediating a target resource, including counts of resolved, severity-reduced, and unchanged findings, and per-finding before/after detail.

renewable_eligibility.caption: Renewable Eligibility
renewable_eligibility.description: Indicates if the certificate is eligible for renewal

repository_name.caption: Repository Name
repository_name.description: The name of the repository. See specific usage.

resolved_findings_count.caption: Resolved Findings Count
resolved_findings_count.description: The number of findings that will be fully resolved by remediating this target.

scan_duration.caption: Scan Duration
scan_duration.description: The time span of the network scan job, including start time, end time, and total duration.

scanner_endpoint.caption: Scanner Endpoint
scanner_endpoint.description: The network endpoint of the scanner source that executed the scan probes.

security_groups.caption: Array of Security groups
security_groups.description: The array of security groups associated with the resource

severity_reduction_findings_count.caption: Severity Reduction Findings Count
severity_reduction_findings_count.description: The number of findings that will have reduced severity after remediating this target.

severity_unchanged_findings_count.caption: Severity Unchanged Findings Count
severity_unchanged_findings_count.description: The number of findings that will remain at the same severity after remediating this target.

snapshot_details.caption: Snapshot Details
snapshot_details.description: The details of the database snapshot.

snapshot_id.caption: Snapshot ID
snapshot_id.description: The storage device snapshot identifier (e.g. snap-1234567890abcdef0).

storage_device.caption: Storage Device
storage_device.description: The storage device that is attached to the instance

subnet_group.caption: Subnet Group
subnet_group.description: The subnet group that is associated with the database

subnet_info.caption: Subnet Information
subnet_info.description: Describes the supporting information about a subnet.

subnet_info_list.caption: List of Subnet Information
subnet_info_list.description: A list of supporting information about a subnet.

target_trait.caption: Target Trait
target_trait.description: The security trait that this remediation target addresses. One remediation target finding is generated per resource type and trait combination.

tcp_banner.caption: TCP Banner
tcp_banner.description: A sanitized snippet of a service banner received from a scanned port over TCP, such as an SSH greeting, SMTP 220 response, or FTP welcome message.

update_reason.caption: Update Reason
update_reason.description: The reason a CVSS metric was modified by the vendor.

updated_severity.caption: Updated Severity
updated_severity.description: The projected severity of the finding after remediation, normalized to the caption of the updated_severity_id value.

updated_severity_id.caption: Updated Severity ID
updated_severity_id.description: The projected normalized severity identifier of the finding after remediation. Values mirror the core OCSF severity_id enum.

2.caption: Low
2.description: The user decides if action is needed.

3.caption: Medium
3.description: Action is required but the situation is not serious at this time.

5.caption: Critical
5.description: Action is required immediately and the scope is broad.

6.caption: Fatal
6.description: An error occurred but it is too late to take remedial action.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The severity is not mapped. See the updated_severity attribute, which contains a data source specific value.

updated_traits.caption: Updated Traits
updated_traits.description: The security traits that will remain on the finding after remediation.

vendor_score.caption: Vendor Score
vendor_score.description: The vendor-determined score for the finding, reflecting any adjustments applied by the event source. For example, the vendor's adjusted CVSS score after applying environmental metrics.
